items.title: Steam Week in Review: more than half of new Steam games will have an AI disclosure by 2027-2028
items.excerpt: Tracking Steam's AI-disclosure data, PC Gamer projects that AI-flagged games cross the 50% mark of all releases between 2027 and 2028, with roughly one in three new games already disclosing generative-AI content. Signals how mainstream AI-assisted game-making is becoming.

items.title: Houdini 22 Is Out Now, Bringing Native Gaussian Splats, New UI, and More
items.excerpt: SideFX shipped Houdini 22 with native Gaussian Splats (neural radiance-field capture), a redesigned UI, Copernicus and KineFX upgrades, and new rendering workflows for game and VFX production. Brings AI-adjacent neural-capture tooling into a core game-art content pipeline.
